statements.certification: DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_CERTIFIED: model studies, never a strategy backtest or a performance claim
statements.sample: deterministic sha256(TICKER|date) prefix of the candidate days, outcome-independent but NOT automatically representative: NOT a representative backtest of all candidates and not to be extrapolated; the Supertrader 6.0 stratified samples equalise the sampling fraction per year x liquidity [x regime] stratum, they remain samples
statements.iexVolume: IEX venue only (1-5 % of the consolidated volume): compared only with IEX volume, never treated as market volume
statements.shorts: every PS trade is a hypothetical one-unit short; borrow, locates and fees unknown (KK-030 DATA_BLOCKED): never a historically executable short sale
statements.license: Tiingo IEX minutes for internal, non-displaying use: private cache and owner-encrypted results only; public outputs carry counts and hashes, never minute values

ownerDecision: chart-first 2026-10-23: no news / catalyst database, no new data provider, IEX minutes of the existing Tiingo access only

findings: IEX 1- and 5-minute bars for all 17 EP / PS days (2020-2024, incl. delisted TWTR), 390 minutes each; SNAP IPO day 281 minutes
5-minute bars equal aggregated 1-minute bars (prices and volume)
IEX volume share of the consolidated daily volume 1.0-4.8 %
IEX high / low vs consolidated daily bar mostly <= 0.1 %, at most 1.7 % (GME 2021-01-28 low); first IEX print vs official open <= 0.8 %
opening range 5 / 15 / 30, IEX VWAP (inside the daily range) and relative IEX opening volume computable
Tiingo "consolidated" beta endpoint: same prices as IEX, no volume field (as R10)
IEX range request NVDA 2023-04-24..2023-05-24: resampleFreq=1day rejected (400, "Min or Hour only")
4hour: 23 bars for 23 sessions, all with IEX volume; 1hour: 138 bars, 23 sessions -> the 20-session IEX volume baseline costs one request (4hour, fallback 1hour)

candidateCounts.consequence: all IEX candidate days would need about 93 000 requests (EP: minutes + baseline, PS: minutes); a run fetches at most 6 000, two thirds for EP, as a deterministic hash-order sample (sha256 of TICKER|date), resumable via the private cache

fixes.finding: run-kk-intraday.mjs 1.1.0: EP and PS walk the same sha256 order, EP first; the PS loop skipped every cached key, so PS days that are also EP candidates were cached up to the EP frontier, all other PS days only up to the PS frontier
fixes.before: PS evaluated on every cached PS day (run 39939887192: 2 065 days, 65 of them cached by the EP loop, ~14 expected in an unbiased PS prefix: gap-up PS days ~4.5x over-represented)
fixes.after: PS evaluated on its clean hash prefix only (CLEAN); keys cached only via the EP path beyond it are dropped and counted; BEFORE_FIX is still computed for the comparison

fixes.finding: kk-ep-lifecycle.mjs:113 (1.1.0): a day without IEX baseline is NOT_EXECUTED_NO_IEX_VOLUME_BASELINE under PACE_20 but executable under ALT-NO-VOLUME-RULE
fixes.before: EP variants on different day sets (run 39939887192: REF 103 days NOT_EXECUTED_NO_IEX_VOLUME_BASELINE, 172 EP days with too few IEX baseline sessions; no EP day was cached via the PS path in that run because the PS prefix was shorter than the EP prefix, but the code allowed it)
fixes.after: every EP variant on one common day set (EP prefix, minutes and baseline mean > 0); excluded days counted per reason; cached days outside the set are NOT_EVALUATED_OUTSIDE_DAY_SET for every variant

fixes.finding: kk-ps-study.mjs:151 / run-kk-intraday.mjs:273-278 (1.1.0): OPEN_AT_DATA_END only in the status counts, never in the metrics
fixes.before: open shorts (incl. delisted securities) silently left out of every metric
fixes.after: counted publicly (openAtDataEnd, by terminal cause); sealed metrics closedOnly (unchanged population) and withOpenMarked (marked to the last finite close with exit costs)

fixes.before: upper median for an even trade count
fixes.after: proper median (mean of the two middle values); only sealed medians of even-count variants change, nothing pinned

additions.cacheOnly: workflow mode kk-intraday-cache: --cache-only, both fetch loops skipped, no API key, 0 requests asserted (mandate: use the existing cache first, no additional requests)

samplingAssumptions.reference: per method the longest hash-order prefix of its own candidate keys that its own fetch path reached: EP up to the highest-ranked EP key with a cached baseline (only the EP path fetches baselines), PS up to the highest-ranked cached PS key that is not an EP candidate (only the PS path can have cached it). Cached keys beyond the prefix are dropped; keys inside it without a definitive answer are reported as holes
samplingAssumptions.why: review 6.0: the PS loop skipped keys cached by the EP loop, over-representing gap-up PS days

samplingAssumptions.reference: every EP variant runs on one day set: keys in the EP prefix with minutes and an IEX volume baseline (mean > 0); days with too few IEX baseline sessions or too little history are excluded for ALL variants and counted
samplingAssumptions.why: review 6.0: PACE_20 and NONE ran on different day sets; the baseline is known at the prior close (point in time)

samplingAssumptions.reference: calendar year of the trade day
samplingAssumptions.why: known at the decision; IEX coverage and market conditions differ by year

samplingAssumptions.reference: mean raw dollar volume (raw close x raw volume) of the 20 sessions before the trade day, fixed nominal bounds: LIQ_1M_10M < 10 M <= LIQ_10M_100M < 100 M <= LIQ_100M_PLUS (USD); NA if a session is missing
samplingAssumptions.why: fixed decade bounds chosen before any result, known at the decision (population terciles would use later candidates); same measure as the universe floor (1 M). Nominal, not inflation adjusted

samplingAssumptions.reference: SPY adjusted close of the prior session above its 200-session SMA (SPY_ABOVE_SMA200) or not (SPY_AT_OR_BELOW_SMA200); NA under 200 sessions. Optional dimension (scheme YEAR_X_LIQUIDITY_X_REGIME)
samplingAssumptions.why: common market-regime convention, known at the prior close

samplingAssumptions.reference: a stratum takes part only with at least 100 candidate keys (population); smaller strata are excluded from the stratified evaluation and counted
samplingAssumptions.why: the common fraction is the minimum over strata; tiny strata would drive it toward zero by chance

samplingAssumptions.reference: common fraction f = min over eligible strata of (cached keys in the clean prefix / population); each eligible stratum keeps its first floor(f x population) cached prefix keys in hash order
samplingAssumptions.why: equal sampling fraction per stratum; hash rank inside the stratum stays outcome-independent

C09.label: CHART_EP_MODEL_STUDY_IEX_INTRADAY_NOT_AN_ORIGINAL_EPISODIC_PIVOT

layers.A_DAILY_SCREEN: frozen research snapshot, all history, decided at the official open of the gap day
layers.B_INTRADAY_IEX: REAL Tiingo IEX minutes 2017+, decided in time order; no minute derived from a daily bar

C09.engine: shared research engine (research-v1), order type INTRADAY_RESOLVED

modelAssumptions.reference: NOT_VERIFIED: no catalyst filter; no setup is an original EP
modelAssumptions.why: owner decision 2026-10-23: chart-first, no news / catalyst history (KK-SF-EP-CATALYST DATA_BLOCKED)

modelAssumptions.reference: a candidate needs 64 prior sessions in the snapshot (63-session range / run evidence + prior close)
modelAssumptions.why: the quiet-phase evidence (KK-035) and its alternative read 63 sessions; a shorter history is not screened (IPO gaps are therefore excluded, declared)

modelAssumptions.reference: first IEX print within the first 5 minutes and within 5 % of the raw official open; otherwise not executed. The whole-day IEX high / low agreement (R9, 1 %) is evidence only
modelAssumptions.why: tickers are reused after delistings; the gate must be known at the decision, a whole-day check would select days by their outcome

modelAssumptions.reference: every IEX minute after the fill is taken as printed (no per-minute outlier filter); a single bad print can trigger the same-day stop
modelAssumptions.why: a filter would need the day after the decision; the whole-day agreement is reported as evidence (dayRangeAgreement)

modelAssumptions.reference: official open / prior close - 1 >= 10 % (KK-015 printed size as a declared screen convention)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-015 is a STRONG_PREFERENCE description; the printed 10 % is the only number the source gives

modelAssumptions.reference: NONE: the prior range and run are evidence only (KK-SF-EP-SIDEWAYS manual)
alternatives: PRIOR_RUN_LIMIT_50: prior close at most 50 % above the lowest low of the 63 sessions before the gap ("without a big prior run", declared convention)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-035 "ideally 3-6 months sideways" gives no measure

modelAssumptions.reference: PACE_20: before the entry minute k <= 20 the cumulative IEX volume since the open is at least the mean IEX daily volume of the 20 prior sessions x k / 20; after minute 20 only if the IEX volume of minutes 0-19 reached that average. Baseline: mean over all 20 prior sessions (a session without IEX volume counts 0), only when at least 15 of them have IEX volume, otherwise not executed
alternatives: NONE: no volume condition (volume reported as evidence)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-037 "ideally the daily average within 15-20 minutes" read on the IEX venue only (IEX is 1-5 % of the market; never compared with consolidated volume)

modelAssumptions.reference: ORH_1: buy stop one raw cent above the opening range of the first session minute (its IEX high and the official open), active from minute 1
alternatives: ORH_5: above the 5-minute opening range high, active from minute 5 (KK-033)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-032 "mostly the first 1-minute opening range high"

modelAssumptions.reference: fill = max(level, open of the first IEX minute whose high reaches the level) (IEX prints can jump; never better than the level)
modelAssumptions.why: IEX is one venue; a consolidated fill price is not known

modelAssumptions.reference: low of day = min(official open, IEX lows of the minutes BEFORE the fill minute)
modelAssumptions.why: the opening auction is not an IEX print (R9 A4); the fill minute's own low is not known to precede the fill

modelAssumptions.reference: PESSIMISTIC: a fill minute whose low reaches the stop exits at the stop
modelAssumptions.why: inside one minute the order of the fill and the low is unknown

modelAssumptions.reference: MA20: first daily close below the 20-day MA exits at the next open (plus the low-of-day stop-market)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-017 names 20 / 50 and later 10 / 20-day MAs (SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, KK-C2); 20 is named in both readings

modelAssumptions.reference: RISK 0.005 of equity to the low-of-day stop, KK-001 cap 30 % (platform 25 %)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-SF-SIZE is the reviewer's; the printed context ranges KK-003 / KK-025

modelAssumptions.reference: VU_TOURNAMENT_UNIVERSE_705 at the session before the gap day
modelAssumptions.why: measurement convention shared by every method

modelAssumptions.reference: all variants of one evaluation run on the same day set (research/kk-sample.mjs MA-SAMPLE-EP-COMMON-DAY-SET): a cached day outside it is NOT_EVALUATED_OUTSIDE_DAY_SET for every variant
modelAssumptions.why: Supertrader 6.0 review: PACE_20 and NONE ran on different day sets (days without IEX baseline)

modelAssumptions.reference: 10 bps slippage per side, 1 bp commission (platform policy)
modelAssumptions.why: no costs in the source

blockers: catalyst identity and timestamp (KK-015 / -038 / -039 / -040): DATA_BLOCKED by owner decision (no news database)
consolidated intraday volume: only the IEX venue (1-5 %) is available; KK-016 / -037 read on IEX only
intraday history before 2017 (IEX starts 2017): candidates 2016 are screened, never simulated
minute cache is private and not frozen in the research snapshot: reproducible via its sha256 in the sealed receipt, not certifiable
request budget: one run covers a deterministic hash-order sample of the candidate days, not all of them (no mass download)

C10.label: CHART_PS_SHORT_MODEL_STUDY_TRADE_LEVEL_NO_BORROW_DATA_NOT_EXECUTABLE

classes.why: no historical borrow / locate / fee data

layers.A_DAILY_SCREEN: frozen research snapshot, all history, decided at the close before the trade day
layers.B_INTRADAY_IEX: REAL Tiingo IEX minutes 2017+, decided in time order; no minute derived from a daily bar

C10.engine: trade-level short study (no portfolio, no borrow cost)

modelAssumptions.reference: STREAK3_ACCEL: at the close before the trade day at least 3 consecutive higher closes, each return >= the one before, their sum >= 3 x ADR20 and the close above the 10-day MA
modelAssumptions.why: KK-018 "several strongly accelerated up days" has no number; KK-019 sizes are examples only. ADR20 (KK-031) scales "strongly" to the stock

modelAssumptions.reference: a candidate needs 31 sessions up to the signal close
modelAssumptions.why: ADR20, the 10-day MA and the streak evidence need them; shorter histories are not screened (declared)

modelAssumptions.reference: first IEX print within the first 5 minutes and within 5 % of the raw official open; the whole-day high / low agreement (R9) is evidence only
modelAssumptions.why: ticker reuse; the gate must be known at the decision, never selected by the day's outcome

modelAssumptions.reference: every IEX minute after the fill is taken as printed (no per-minute outlier filter); a single bad print can trigger the stop or a target
modelAssumptions.why: a filter would need the day after the decision; the whole-day agreement is reported per trade (dayRangeAgreement)

modelAssumptions.reference: ORL_5: short one raw cent below the 5-minute opening range low (IEX lows and the official open), active from minute 5
alternatives: FIRST_RED_5MIN: below the low of the first completed red 5-minute candle
FAILED_VWAP_RETEST: after a minute closed below the IEX VWAP, the first minute that trades up to the VWAP and closes below it; short at that close
modelAssumptions.why: KK-020 / KK-021 (OPTIONAL) leave the choice open; "ORL" names no length, 5 minutes matches the 5-minute candle of KK-020

modelAssumptions.reference: fill = min(level, open of the first IEX minute whose low reaches the level) (never better than the level)
modelAssumptions.why: IEX prints can jump; a consolidated fill is not known

modelAssumptions.reference: HOD: buy stop one raw cent above the high of day before the fill minute (official open included), stop-market
alternatives: VWAP_RECLAIM: cover at the close of the first minute after the fill that closes above the IEX VWAP (high-of-day stop kept as the hard stop)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-022 (CONTEXTUAL) names both

modelAssumptions.reference: MA10: cover the whole position at the 10-day MA of the prior close (limit; an open below it covers at the open)
modelAssumptions.why: KK-023 (PREFERENCE) "toward the 10 / 20-day MA, early partials" gives no split

modelAssumptions.reference: PESSIMISTIC: a minute (or daily bar) that reaches both the stop and the target is a stop
modelAssumptions.why: the order inside one bar is unknown

modelAssumptions.reference: NOT MODELLED: borrow availability, locates and fees are unknown; a trade is a hypothetical short
modelAssumptions.why: KK-SF-PS-BORROW DATA_BLOCKED (KK-030); never an executable short

modelAssumptions.reference: VU_TOURNAMENT_UNIVERSE_705 at the session before the trade day
modelAssumptions.why: measurement convention shared by every method

modelAssumptions.reference: 10 bps slippage per side, 1 bp commission; no borrow fee (unknown)
modelAssumptions.why: platform policy; borrow DATA_BLOCKED

modelAssumptions.reference: INDEPENDENT: every candidate day is its own hypothetical one-unit short, also while an earlier short of the same security (same streak) is still open
alternatives: ONE_POSITION_PER_TICKER (reporting variant): a candidate is skipped while an earlier PS trade of the same security is open; open means its last cover is on or after the candidate day (a cover on the candidate day itself counts as open, conservative), a trade open at the data end blocks every later candidate
modelAssumptions.why: Supertrader 6.0 review: consecutive candidate days of one streak ran as overlapping trades; the source says nothing about re-entries

modelAssumptions.reference: a short still open at the data end (incl. a delisted security) is counted publicly and, sealed, marked to the last finite daily close of its series with exit costs (closed-only metrics are kept as the reference)
modelAssumptions.why: Supertrader 6.0 review: excluding them silently drops the trades that never reached the stop or the target

blockers: borrow availability, locates and fees (KK-030): DATA_BLOCKED, every short is hypothetical
no short book on the shared engine: trade-level study only, no portfolio return
consolidated intraday prices and volume: IEX venue only; VWAP is an IEX VWAP
request budget: PS gets the third of a run budget left after EP, a deterministic hash-order sample of 65 216 days
